_comment: Source-of-truth for what to fetch and how to parse it. Selectors are tuned against a live sample the first time you run scripts/fetch.mjs (it saves raw HTML to data/raw/ for exactly this). Nothing here is guessed at runtime — the fetcher and parser read only this file.

revisor.label: Missouri Revisor of Statutes (official)
revisor._engine_note: revisor.mo.gov is bot-protected (returns 403 to plain fetch / cloud IPs). Playwright drives the pre-installed Chromium and defeats it. Fall back to the 'justia' source if a section 403s repeatedly.

justia.label: Justia US Codes (mirror, clean HTML)
justia._engine_note: Justia sits behind Cloudflare and 403s a plain fetch; a real browser passes. Content is static, so Playwright reads it directly.

chapters.label: Income Tax
chapters.note: Core. Individual + fiduciary + corporate income tax, S-corp treatment (143.471), and the SALT Parity / pass-through entity election (143.436).

supplemental._comment: DOR guidance/forms are HTML/PDF, not statute. Ingested as separate parents with authority='guidance' so they never outrank statute in citation. Statute is the letter of the law; these explain administration. entity[] here is the curated tag set directly (these pages are few and hand-reviewed, so they skip the classify()/entity-map.json range machinery that chapters use) -- never inferred.

regulations._comment: 12 CSR 10 -- Missouri Dept. of Revenue regulations (Code of State Regulations, Title 12, Division 10), promulgated under statutory authority. Binding administrative detail the statute underspecifies (docs/SOURCES.md). authority='regulation' -- ranks below statute, above informal FAQ guidance. PDF-served by the Secretary of State (sos.mo.gov), not HTML -- parsed via pdf-parse (Node), a separate code path from the HTML selector pipeline (see scripts/fetch.mjs fetchRegulations / pipeline/lib/parse.mjs parsePdfBuffer).
regulations._divisions_note: Division numbers below are a STARTING SET confirmed to exist (seen via direct search of sos.mo.gov), not a verified-complete list. indexUrl is not yet wired for auto-discovery -- its link markup hasn't been inspected against a live fetch. Treat this the same as statute chapters: extend `divisions` as more are confirmed, or wire chapter-index discovery once the index page's HTML shape is known.
